name: 🥘 Cozy Cabin Chili
tagline: A thick, beefy one-pot chili that tastes like it simmered all day in about 45 minutes.

steps.text: Brown the beef in a big pot over medium-high, pressed flat, without stirring for 4 minutes. Then crumble and cook through.
Push the beef aside, add a splash of oil, the onion and a pinch of salt. Cook until soft.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin and tomato paste. Cook 1 minute until it smells toasty.
Add the tomatoes, chili beans with their sauce, brown sugar and ½ cup water.
Simmer uncovered, stirring now and then, until thick.
Taste: more salt, a pinch more sugar if it's sharp. Meanwhile grate the cheese and set out toppings.
Ladle into bowls; top with cheddar and sour cream.

kid_jobs.job: Open the cans and pour them in (grown-up does the can opener)
Set up toppings: cheese, sour cream, chips
Stir the pot with a long spoon (stand on a stool)

chef_tip: Toast the spices in the fat for a minute before the liquid goes in. It's the difference between dusty chili and deep, rich chili.
make_ahead: Even better on day two. Cool, refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 3 months.
leftovers: Chili over a baked potato, or chili cheese nachos with tortilla chips.
swaps: Ground turkey 94% for a lighter pot
Add a can of black beans to stretch it
serve_with: Tortilla chips, or cornbread from the Bisquick box
heads_up: Dice the onion first so it's ready when the beef is browned.

game_plan.what: Dice the onion. Beef into the big pot to brown.
Onion in, then garlic, spices and tomato paste.
Tomatoes, beans, sugar and water in. Simmer.
Kids grate cheese and set out toppings.
Taste: salt, maybe a pinch of sugar.
Ladle into bowls, top and serve.
